use_case: Dam-safety sensor anomaly detection: a machine learning model in the DSMS scores instrument readings (piezometers, seepage weirs, inclinometers, reservoir and tailwater levels) for patterns that suggest a developing failure mode
vendor_or_model: Company-built model on Cloud provider B managed machine learning; trained on company dams 2010-2026 and opted-in client dams
data_categories: Instrument readings, rainfall, reservoir levels for 52 company dams and 138 client dams; no personal information; alert content describing failure modes treated as CEII
human_in_the_loop: Advisory only. Alerts go to dam safety technicians (company dams) or client staff (SL-2); trigger-point checks and manual trend reviews continue unchanged and cannot be reduced without council and Chief Dam Safety Engineer approval
applicable_laws: 18 CFR 12.10(a) and 12.3(b)(4)(viii) (unusual readings must be reported; AI output does not change the duty); FERC Security Program Rev. 3A 3.2 (trigger points) and Section 9 (one-way data path); FTC Act Section 5 (claims to SL-2 clients); SL-2 client agreements
status: In production (advisory) for company dams since 2025-11 and for SL-2 clients since 2026-03
ot_or_safety_interaction: Reads OT data one way through diodes; no output flows back to OT
performance_disparity_testing: Partial: recall gaps for manually read instruments and hourly-reporting client dams (section 7)
monitoring: Monthly alert statistics; quarterly disparity tests by instrument type, dam type, reading frequency, and season

use_case: Turbine and generator condition monitoring that flags vibration and temperature trends for maintenance planning
vendor_or_model: Governor and turbine OEM analytics SaaS
data_categories: Unit vibration, temperature, and operating data from the OT DMZ historian replica
human_in_the_loop: Maintenance planners review every flag before creating a work order; no control actions
applicable_laws: OEM contract (POAM-014 terms); FERC Security Program Section 9 (data leaves OT one way)
performance_disparity_testing: Not applicable (no decisions about people); false-negative rate by unit type tracked
monitoring: Quarterly precision and recall against maintenance findings

use_case: Generation dispatch and water-value optimization recommending unit commitment and reservoir drawdown for the day-ahead schedule
data_categories: Prices, inflow forecasts, reservoir levels, unit availability, license limits
human_in_the_loop: Schedulers review and approve every schedule; license limits and reservoir rule curves are enforced in SCADA and cannot be overridden by the tool
applicable_laws: License articles (minimum flows, reservoir limits); NERC and Balancing Authority scheduling obligations (contract)
ot_or_safety_interaction: None directly; schedules reach the HOC through the OT DMZ file transfer and operators apply them
performance_disparity_testing: Not applicable; recommendation quality tested by season and river system
monitoring: Monthly comparison of recommended and actual schedules; license-limit near-miss report

use_case: Reservoir inflow forecasting (machine learning ensemble) used for reservoir planning ahead of storms
vendor_or_model: Company-built model on Cloud provider B with public weather data
data_categories: Rainfall, river gauges, snow and soil data, reservoir history; no personal information
human_in_the_loop: Forecasts are advisory; reservoir operating plans and flood procedures govern gate settings; operators may not set gates directly from model output (P01 R-062)
applicable_laws: 18 CFR 12.3(b)(4)(xii) (floods are conditions affecting safety); EAPs; license articles
ot_or_safety_interaction: None; forecasts shown on HOC displays as information only
performance_disparity_testing: Partial: error by basin size and storm type tracked; small basins underperform
monitoring: Forecast error after every storm over the threshold rainfall; seasonal review

use_case: Drone and camera imagery analysis that flags concrete cracking, spalling, and embankment anomalies for dam safety inspections
data_categories: Drone and fixed camera imagery of project works (CEII)
human_in_the_loop: Engineers review every flag; Part 12D inspections and engineer judgment unchanged
applicable_laws: 18 CFR Part 12 Subpart D (independent consultant inspections unchanged); CEII handling (POL-04)
ot_or_safety_interaction: None; imagery leaves through the inspection program, not OT
monitoring: Pilot comparison of flags with engineer findings

use_case: SOC alert triage assistant that groups and ranks security alerts
data_categories: Security alerts and logs, including OT sensor alerts
human_in_the_loop: Analysts review every case; the assistant cannot close OT alerts
applicable_laws: POL-04 (logs are Confidential; BCSI in OT alerts)
ot_or_safety_interaction: Reads OT sensor alerts in the SIEM; no OT access
monitoring: Monthly sample of closed cases for missed escalations

use_case: Video analytics that detect people and vehicles in restricted zones at Group 1 and 2 dams
vendor_or_model: Video management vendor analytics (no facial recognition)
data_categories: Camera video of restricted areas and nearby public areas
human_in_the_loop: Security dispatch reviews every alert before dispatching officers; no automated enforcement
applicable_laws: FERC Security Program Rev. 3A (Security Plans); state laws on video surveillance (counsel review); no facial recognition used
performance_disparity_testing: Alert accuracy by camera, lighting, and weather; no demographic features used
monitoring: Monthly false alarm and missed-detection review

human_in_the_loop: Traders decide every trade within risk limits
applicable_laws: Commodity trading risk policy; FERC market behavior rules apply to trading conduct (not to the tool itself)
